added.description: Time and date the job was added to the queue in ISO8601 format in UTC

finished.description: Time and date the job was finished in ISO8601 format in UTC

hasData.description: True if the job was not created from a fetched file

itemCount.description: The number of items processed, only for job types REFRESH and ADJUST

jobID.description: Internal identifier that uniquely identifies a single job

locationCode.description: Unique internal Identifier of the owning location

originalFilename.description: The full name of the file that was picked up at the secure droppoint server before being split up by location. Applies only to refresh and adjust jobs created via file fetch process

started.description: Time and date the job was started in ISO8601 format in UTC

tenantID.description: Unique internal identifier of the tenant that owns the job
